market_question: Will France send warships through the Strait of Hormuz by May 31, 2026?
reasoning: France actively participates in the European-led EMASoH/Operation Agenor mission, which regularly transits the Strait of Hormuz to ensure freedom of navigation. France also maintains a permanent naval base in Abu Dhabi and routinely deploys frigates in the region. With over a year until May 2026, the probability of at least one qualifying French warship transit is very high.
evidence_points: France is a core contributor to the EMASoH maritime surveillance mission, which has been conducting transits of the Strait of Hormuz since 2020.
The French Navy maintains a permanent forward base at Camp de la Paix in Abu Dhabi, enabling frequent deployments in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.
The market's timeframe spans more than 14 months, during which routine patrols and escort duties make a French warship transit practically certain.
sources_consulted: Official EMASoH mission statements and press releases
French Navy deployment reports and regional presence documentation
Recent credible news reporting on Operation Agenor and Strait of Hormuz transits
